items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was really great, and you met the great Tab ... [INTERVIEWEE] Tab Smith.

ctx.x: I mean, I hit him and he waited. I hit Deak, and he waited, and Bill Kinney waited, and I got 17. So I turned my hand out; I beat Lucky -- Deak beats me; Tab beat me and Bill Kinney beat me.
